title: Slushie Bar Salts Mr Blue 10ml E-Liquid
description: Mr Blue in the Slushie Bar Salts lineup is a deliciously sweet and satisfying e-liquid that perfectly captures the fun flavour of a blue raspberry slush. This blend combines the sweet and slightly tart notes of plump blueberries and tangy raspberries, resulting in a vibrant and exhilarating taste. Each inhale brings a burst of fruity sweetness, reminiscent of a refreshing slushie drink, ideal for satisfying those sweet cravings. The blend is more than just a simple fruit mix; it's an experience that conjures up memories of enjoying a cool, flavourful slush on a warm day. The balanced mix of blueberries and raspberries in this e-liquid offers a complex yet harmonious profile, making it an excellent choice for vapers seeking a blend that is both sweet and tangy, with an underlying slushie-inspired freshness. Slushie Bar Salts' Mr Blue is an inviting option for those who enjoy bold, fruity flavours This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
